invite: 今天想先探索哪一個山谷？
要一起去找恐龍嗎？
我們來聽聽看，牠在說什麼。
准备好幫聖誕老人了嗎？
這一次要挑戰哪一種玩法呢？
要不要來比比看誰的耳朵比較靈？
跟我走，我帶你去恐龍谷。
那邊好像有聲音，你要不要聽聽看？
今天的任務來了，我們開始吧。
這隻恐龍等你好久囉。
來看看這次的題目是什麼。
我會一直陪著你。
深呼吸，我們慢慢來。
你的耳朵今天特別靈。
看看這關會出現什麼新玩法。
星星又落下來了，我們去撿嗎？
這關有個新朋友在等你。
聽，遠處有恐龍在叫。
戴好耳朵，我們出發囉。
今天的題目藏得很好玩。
要不要跟著我走一趟？
encourage: 這一次你聽得更仔細了。
hint: 我把這個聲音再放慢一次。
這次的提示只有一點點喔。
celebrate: 這隻恐龍已經加入你的圖鑑
這是我見過最棒的一次
這是今天的第一枚星星。
comfort: 沒關係，錯誤也是探險的一部分。

letters.prologue: 親愛的孩子：今年聖誕夜，我需要你的幫忙。恐龍谷的星星走失了，牠們聽得見聲音，可是沒有人聽得見牠們。願意幫我嗎？—— 聖誕老人
letters.epilogue: 你做到了！這封信可以列印給你，貼在你的聖誕樹上。謝謝你，親愛的孩子。 —— 聖誕老人

dino-triceratops.zh-TW: {name}說：我聽到你說話了，聽得很清楚喔！
dino-triceratops.en-US: {name} says: I heard you loud and clear!

dino-triceratops.zh-TW: {name}說：我的角可以幫你擋風雪，你慢慢聽。
dino-triceratops.en-US: {name} says: My horns can block the snow. Take your time.

dino-triceratops.zh-TW: {name}說：別急，我們一起聽會更清楚。
dino-triceratops.en-US: {name} says: No rush. We listen better together.

dino-trex.zh-TW: {name}說：別擔心，答錯也沒關係，我力氣大，心很軟。
dino-trex.en-US: {name} says: Do not worry. I am big but my heart is soft.
{name} says: I will say it once more. Listen slowly.

dino-brachiosaurus.en-US: {name} says: My neck is long. I hear farther than anyone!

dino-brachiosaurus.zh-TW: {name}說：遠處有聲音，我幫你接回來。
dino-brachiosaurus.en-US: {name} says: There is a sound far away. I will bring it back.
{name} says: Clap along. One, two, three!

dino-pteranodon.en-US: {name} says: I fly high, so I hear far.

dino-pteranodon.zh-TW: {name}說：天空傳來一個聲音，我帶回來了！
dino-pteranodon.en-US: {name} says: A sound came from the sky. I brought it back!
{name} says: Look down. The answer is there.

dino-stegosaurus.en-US: {name} says: My plates shake with the beat!
{name} says: Ta, ta, ta. Clap with me.
{name} says: You keep the beat better than I do.

dino-velociraptor.en-US: {name} says: I am the fastest. Let me listen first!

dino-velociraptor.zh-TW: {name}說：好多聲音混在一起，我抓到對的那個了！
dino-velociraptor.en-US: {name} says: So many sounds mixed up. I caught the right one!

dino-ankylosaurus.en-US: {name} says: My tail sounds like a drum!
{name} says: The strong beat is here. Bam!

dino-ankylosaurus.zh-TW: {name}說：我站穩了，你跟著節奏就好。
dino-ankylosaurus.en-US: {name} says: I am standing steady. Just follow the beat.

dino-parasaurolophus.en-US: {name} says: My crest can make sounds!
{name} says: You say it, then I say it back.
{name} says: Listen. Do I sound right?

dino-allosaurus.en-US: {name} says: I am the best at copying other roars!

dino-allosaurus.zh-TW: {name}說：欸？我剛才是不是排錯順序了？
dino-allosaurus.en-US: {name} says: Hmm? Did I get them out of order?
{name} says: No problem. Let us line them up again.

dino-carnotaurus.zh-TW: {name}說：我的角很特別，聽得出細細的差別。
dino-carnotaurus.en-US: {name} says: My horns are special. I hear tiny differences.

dino-carnotaurus.zh-TW: {name}說：這兩個聲音，有一點點不一樣。
dino-carnotaurus.en-US: {name} says: These two sounds are a little different.

dino-carnotaurus.zh-TW: {name}說：很小很小的地方，我也能聽見。
dino-carnotaurus.en-US: {name} says: Even the tiniest bit, I hear it.

dino-iguanodon.en-US: {name} says: Clap with my thumb spike!
{name} says: Nice rhythm. Keep it going.

dino-iguanodon.zh-TW: {name}說：慢一點也沒關係，節奏可以很慢。
dino-iguanodon.en-US: {name} says: Slower is fine too. A beat can be slow.

dino-trachodon.zh-TW: {name}說：我的嘴巴扁扁的，最會哼長音。
dino-trachodon.en-US: {name} says: My mouth is flat. I hum the longest notes.
{name} says: Try stretching the sound a little.

dino-tyrannosaurus.en-US: {name} says: Do not be afraid. I do not eat people.
{name} says: I am right here. You talk, I listen.

dino-tyrannosaurus.zh-TW: {name}說：最大的恐龍，也怕聽錯題目。
dino-tyrannosaurus.en-US: {name} says: Even the biggest dinosaur worries about missing a question.

dino-diplodocus.zh-TW: {name}說：我的尾巴超長，能記很長的順序。
dino-diplodocus.en-US: {name} says: My tail is so long. I remember long sequences.
{name} says: One, two, three, four, five. Still remember?
{name} says: Take your time. My tail has plenty of patience.

dino-compysognathus.en-US: {name} says: I am the smallest, but my voice is the sharpest!
{name} says: Tada! Did you hear that?

dino-dilophosaurus.zh-TW: {name}說：我的兩片冠狀骨會張開，像在唱歌。
dino-dilophosaurus.en-US: {name} says: My two crests open wide, like singing.
{name} says: Open your mouth and sing one with me.

dino-tyrannosaurus-scout.en-US: {name} says: I know this path. Follow me.

dino-tyrannosaurus-scout.zh-TW: {name}說：這裡亂亂的，答案藏在裡面。
dino-tyrannosaurus-scout.en-US: {name} says: It is noisy here. The answer hides inside.

dino-tyrannosaurus-scout.zh-TW: {name}說：我當斥候，專找藏在雜音裡的那個。
dino-tyrannosaurus-scout.en-US: {name} says: I am the scout. I find the one hidden in the noise.

dino-spinosaurus.zh-TW: {name}說：我背上的帆船能收水面上的聲音。
dino-spinosaurus.en-US: {name} says: My sail catches the sounds on water.
{name} says: The water tells us answers too.

dino-maiasaura.zh-TW: {name}說：第一次聽都會怕，這很正常。
dino-maiasaura.en-US: {name} says: Everyone is scared the first time. That is normal.

dino-maiasaura.zh-TW: {name}說：我以前也是從很簡單的題目開始的。
dino-maiasaura.en-US: {name} says: I started with very easy questions too.
{name} says: Take your time. I am right here.

dino-oviraptor.zh-TW: {name}說：我叫偷蛋龍，但其實很會照顧蛋。
dino-oviraptor.en-US: {name} says: My name means egg thief, but I am good at caring for eggs.

dino-oviraptor.zh-TW: {name}說：我會幫你把聲音小心捧回來。
dino-oviraptor.en-US: {name} says: I will carry the sound back carefully.

dino-eoraptor.zh-TW: {name}說：我是最古老的恐龍，故事從我開始。
dino-eoraptor.en-US: {name} says: I am the oldest dinosaur. The story starts with me.

dino-eoraptor.zh-TW: {name}說：一開始，什麼都還沒有的時候……
dino-eoraptor.en-US: {name} says: At the beginning, when there was nothing yet...
{name} says: And then, there was the very first sound.

dino-ceratosaurus.en-US: {name} says: The horn on my nose is like a compass.

dino-ceratosaurus.zh-TW: {name}說：往左一點，再一點……就是這裡。
dino-ceratosaurus.en-US: {name} says: A bit to the left, a little more. Right here.

dino-ceratosaurus.zh-TW: {name}說：方向對了，聲音就聽得見了。
dino-ceratosaurus.en-US: {name} says: When the direction is right, the sound comes clear.

dino-giganotosaurus.zh-TW: {name}說：我的聲音很大，但你不用怕。
dino-giganotosaurus.en-US: {name} says: My voice is loud, but you need not be afraid.
{name} says: I will wait for your answer. Take your time.

dino-giganotosaurus.zh-TW: {name}說：聲音再大，也要聽得清楚才算數。
dino-giganotosaurus.en-US: {name} says: A voice can be loud, but it still has to be clear.

dino-mosasaurus.zh-TW: {name}說：我住在深海，聲音傳得比誰都遠。
dino-mosasaurus.en-US: {name} says: I live in the deep sea. My sound travels farther than any.
{name} says: The song under the water, did you hear it?

dino-mosasaurus.zh-TW: {name}說：從最深的海傳來，也是最清楚的。
dino-mosasaurus.en-US: {name} says: From the deepest sea comes the clearest sound.

older: 幫三角龍找回三顆紅色的星星，它們藏在雪地裡。
聽清楚前後兩個音有什麼不同，然後告訴我它們是不是一樣。
用你的耳朵找出藏在干擾聲裡的那個聲音。
把恐龍的腳跡記起來，等一下我要問你哪一格走過。
照著節拍把這八拍拍完，不要搶拍也不要慢拍。
